group.ja: 温度制御・分子動力学

summary.ja: 全粒子の速度に共通係数を掛け、適用時の運動エネルギーを目標値に合わせる。単純な決定論的操作では正準分布の運動エネルギー揺らぎを再現しない。
summary.en: Multiply velocities by a common factor to set the kinetic energy at each application. Simple deterministic rescaling does not reproduce canonical kinetic-energy fluctuations.

caution.ja: 温度への到達と正準分布の標本化を区別するための比較対象。T=0では比による再スケーリングを定義できず、適用間隔も結果に影響する。
caution.en: A comparison case for distinguishing temperature control from canonical sampling. Ratio-based rescaling is undefined at T=0; the application interval also matters.

references.label: GROMACS: temperature coupling
references.scope: Bibliographic entry and introductory comparison; full derivation and numerical reproduction have not been audited.

assumptions: Fix unit masses,kBT1,frequencies1/1.7 and quartic0/.2. Compare NH1,NHC3,Berendsen and fixed-speed baths at two couplings/two steps with256canonical and128heated replicas.
units: Dimensionless, unit masses, kBT=1, frequencies 1/1.7; Q1=2tau², Qj=tau².
boundary_conditions: Two-mode initial-value problem without spatial boundaries; fixed canonical/heated ensembles.

next_deliverable.ja: 固定教育例を維持し、未達の統計・相関目標はそのまま表示します。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain the fixed educational case and retain unmet statistical/correlation goals.

limitations.ja: 著者作成の分割でありLAMMPS/MKT実装の完全再現ではありません。時刻20は混合・平衡化の証明でなく、平均温度一致だけで正準分布や一般的なエルゴード性を認定しません。
limitations.en: This authored splitting is not a full LAMMPS/MKT reproduction. Time20does not prove mixing/equilibration; correct mean temperature alone does not establish canonical sampling or general ergodicity.

title.ja: NH・chain・弱結合・速度固定の比較

summary.ja: 同じ2モード系で、温度平均に加えて分布・揺らぎ・相関を比べます。
summary.en: Compare distributions,fluctuations and correlations as well as mean temperature on the same two-mode systems.

assumptions.ja: 単位質量,kBT=1、周波数1/1.7、quartic係数0/0.2。NH1/NHC3/Berendsen/速度固定、2結合・2刻み、正準256＋加熱128レプリカを固定します。
assumptions.en: Fix unit masses,kBT1,frequencies1/1.7 and quartic0/.2. Compare NH1,NHC3,Berendsen and fixed-speed baths at two couplings/two steps with256canonical and128heated replicas.

algorithm.ja: 明示した凍結変数の厳密bath部分流を対称合成し、各半bathを2副周期で計算します。etaはE部分流だけで進め、独立な全拡張ODEの短時間参照と照合します。
algorithm.en: Symmetrically compose exact frozen-variable bath subflows,two subcycles per half bath. Advance eta only in E subflows and compare short trajectories against independent full extendedODE references.

validation.ja: 物理的時間反転、Hextの微分、phi1、弱結合の局所逆と非可逆な速度固定を別に検査。時刻20の4分布・揺らぎ・符号付き相関とDKWの未確定範囲を残します。
validation.en: Separately test physical reversal,Hext derivative,phi1,local weak-coupling inverses and noninjective rescaling. Retain four distributions,fluctuations,signed correlations and unresolved DKW precision at time20.

limits.ja: 著者作成の分割でありLAMMPS/MKT実装の完全再現ではありません。時刻20は混合・平衡化の証明でなく、平均温度一致だけで正準分布や一般的なエルゴード性を認定しません。
limits.en: This authored splitting is not a full LAMMPS/MKT reproduction. Time20does not prove mixing/equilibration; correct mean temperature alone does not establish canonical sampling or general ergodicity.
